name: skills-utils
description: Small agent-facing utilities. peek loads another repository's always-on context without a session being spawned inside it, and tells each session and subagent when folders below it hold their own AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. mcp-piper adds hooks to every MCP tool call so an agent can send a file on disk as an argument ("@file:<path>") and save a result to disk ("_save_to") without the bytes entering its context, and shows a mermaid.live link under every mermaid diagram on screen.
